BUILT FOR FREEDOM.
This is about way more than a pickup truck. It’s about you. Exercising your freedom. Getting out there. Finding more
places to breathe. Deeply. And recharging yourself. With the kinds of challenging – and rewarding – activities
you call fun. You’ve got the spirit and determination. Now, it’s time to get the gear: the 2020 Ford Ranger.
Backed by over 116 years of innovation, Ranger is built for the freedom-seekers of America. It continues the proud
Ford tradition of building vehicles for those with adventure in their hearts. We’ve been doing it since long before
the interstate even existed. And we intend to keep doing it for the long haul.
